shortVersion: Microsoft's MAI-Code-1. 1-Flash model is now available in GitHub Copilot, providing an updated AI code model for developers in the Copilot ecosystem.
As MAI-Code-1-Flash heads toward deprecation, this upgraded version gives developers a transition path while potentially improving code quality and performance.
